title: An integrated twelve-3U study.
text: Twelve 4 kg 3U envelopes. Two six-level storage banks. One reusable electromagnetic carrier.

title: Select. Feed. Capture.
text: A guided lead screw transfers one payload sideways into the Z-indexed lift. The lift holds the payload and captive pallet.

title: Transfer custody positively.
text: Carrier bayonets and lift grip pins overlap custody at handoff. Prove the destination restraint before releasing the other.

title: Dock. Prove. Clear.
text: The pallet locks to the carrier. The custody frame withdraws clear of the launch path before the shot is enabled.

title: Only the payload departs.
text: The payload departs along +X. The captive pallet remains locked to the carrier through arrest and return to its loading datum.

title: Evaluate the complete trade.
text: Modeled 1–3 m/s commands. Installed device allocation 156.557 kg. These preplanned mission cases show no advantage over the ideal ground-pretrimmed spring comparator.
